name: NoPoSplat
definition: A method that eliminates the need for known camera poses by using a canonical coordinate system anchored to a single input view and introducing intrinsics token embeddings to resolve scale ambiguity.
summary: NoPoSplat is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method for novel view synthesis from sparse, unposed images, eliminating the need for known camera poses by anchoring a canonical coordinate system to a single input view.
